title: mail: Blob/get implementation
description:
Implement GET /jmap/download/{accountId}/{blobId}/{name} in crates/mail/src/blob.rs: parse blobId as CID, fetch raw bytes from IPFS, return as application/octet-stream (or message/rfc822 if the CID is an article root). Require auth. Handle not-found with 404.

Why: Blob/get is how JMAP clients download full message content; without it, clients cannot render message bodies or save attachments.

Acceptance: after POST, Blob/get by that article's CID returns the raw signed article bytes.
